# MILESTONE-AUDIT — Imaginary Notes App

A walking audit of milestones planned against the MVP. Each milestone
has a name, scope summary, status, and exit criteria. Milestones cited
here MUST also appear in MVP-PLAN.md or PRODUCT-BRIEF.md; bare
references without upstream scope are considered orphan references.

## M-1 Discovery

Name: Discovery.
Scope: Validate the problem statement with five target-user
interviews and ship a written summary.
Status: Complete.
Exit criteria: Five interview transcripts on disk plus a synthesis
note linking to the original problem statement.

## M-2 Foundation

Name: Foundation.
Scope: Stand up the framework, database, and deploy pipeline so US-1
can land in M-3.
Status: In progress.
Exit criteria: A deployed empty app reachable at the production URL
with health-check passing.

## M-3 Authentication

Name: Authentication.
Scope: Add user accounts, session management, and per-user note
isolation. This milestone is referenced here but no upstream document
(PRODUCT-BRIEF.md, MVP-PLAN.md) scopes it — the authentication story
was assumed at audit time but never made it back into the brief or
plan.
Status: Planned.
Exit criteria: To be defined.
